start_angle.description: Where the arc starts, radians from +X, counter-clockwise.

sweep.description: How far it turns, radians: positive counter-clockwise.

Copies.description:
A grid of copies of the whole part: copy (column c, row r) is the drawing moved by
(c·dx, r·dy) mm.

dx.description: Distance from copy to copy along X, mm; negative grows to the left.

dy.description: Distance from copy to copy along Y, mm; negative grows downwards.

order.description:
`by_operation`: each operation on every copy, then the next; `by_part`: every
operation on one copy, then the next copy.

CopyOrder.description: In which order the copies are cut.

oneOf.description: Each operation on every copy, then the next operation.
Every operation on one copy, then the next copy.

Corners.description:
How the tool reaches into the inside corners it would leave round, so a square part
fits: every corner on the tool's side up to `max_angle`.

oneOf.description: In along the corner's bisector.

max_angle.description: Only corners this sharp or sharper, radians (1.745 = 100°).

oneOf.description: In along the longer wall: the notch is in the shorter one.

max_angle.description: Only corners this sharp or sharper, radians (1.745 = 100°).

CustomPost.description: A user post-processor's config and template, exactly as read from the posts folder.

config.description: The post's settings file (TOML), as copied.

Drawing.description:
The project's drawing: shapes in millimetres, or (only for jobs from before v4) a
reference to a DXF that still has to be embedded.

next_shape_id.description: The id the next new shape gets. Ids are never reused.

source.description:
The DXF the imported shapes came from, at the last import or update. Null: no DXF
yet.

flattened.description: How many curves of each type (splines, ellipses) were turned into arcs.

ignored.description: How many entities of each type were left out (text, dimensions, …).

imported.description: How many entities of each type were imported.

issues.description: What the import found: the import report.

placement.description: How the imported drawing was moved, turned and scaled on the stock.

sha256.description: The DXF's SHA-256, to tell whether it changed.

units.description: The DXF's units: `mm` or `inch`. Inch drawings are converted to mm on import.

units_from.description: Where the units came from: the DXF itself, or the user's choice.

Entry.description: How the tool goes down into the material at the start of each pass.

oneOf.description: Straight down: needs a centre-cutting tool. An empty struct variant, as `Rings`.

Down along the path and back, never steeper than `ramp_angle` (radians,
0 < angle <= 30°).

ramp_angle.description: The steepest the ramp goes, radians: more than 0, at most 30° (0.5236).

oneOf.description:
Pockets only: down round a circle of `radius` (the tool centre's), never steeper
than `ramp_angle`.

radius.description: The helix's radius, mm: less than the tool radius.

ramp_angle.description: The steepest the helix goes, radians: more than 0, at most 30° (0.5236).

Finish.description: A finishing pass on a profile.

stock.description: Left on the wall by the roughing passes, mm: more than 0, less than the tool radius.

oneOf.description: Straight down at the hole's centre, `peck` mm at a time.

peck.description:
Drill this many mm at a time, lifting out between pecks to clear chips. Null: in
one go.

oneOf.description:
A helix at the wall, at most `step_down` mm per turn and never steeper than
`ramp_angle` (radians, 0 < angle <= 30°), then one level circle.

direction.description: `climb` or `conventional`, as for a profile inside the hole.

ramp_angle.description: The steepest the helix goes, radians: more than 0, at most 30° (0.5236).

step_down.description: The most the helix goes down per turn, mm.

radius.description:
Radius of the lead arcs, mm: more than 0, at most 10 tool diameters. Smaller where
there's no room.

custom_post.description:
Your own post-processor, copied into the project when chosen, so it gives the same
G-code anywhere. Null: `post` is a built-in one.

max_feed.description:
The machine's fastest feed, mm/min: higher feeds are refused, and the cycle time
uses it for rapids. Null: unknown.

name.description: The machine profile these values came from, for reference; nothing reads it.

post.description: The post-processor: `grbl`, `linuxcnc`, `mach3`, or the name of your own.

safe_z.description: The height for rapid moves sideways, mm above Z0. Above the stock top.

tool_change.description:
With several tools: `files` (one file per tool) or `program` (one file with tool
changes).

travel.description:
The machine's travel, mm. When set, a program that moves farther is refused. Null:
not checked.

work_zero.description:
The point of the drawing that becomes X0 Y0 in the G-code. Missing: the drawing's
origin.

clearance.description:
How far the cut moves into the material that is kept, mm: positive removes more (a
larger pocket, a smaller part), negative leaves material. Less than the tool radius.

corners.description:
Dogbones or T-bones in the inside corners, so square parts fit. Null: the corners
stay round.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description:
Where the cut ends, mm down from the stock top. More than the start depth; below the
stock bottom only within `stock.max_overcut`.

entry.description:
How the tool goes down at the start of each pass: `plunge` (straight down; needs a
centre-cutting tool) or `ramp` along the path; pockets also `helix`. Missing:
plunge.

finish.description:
A finishing pass: the roughing passes leave `stock` mm on the wall, and one last lap
at full depth takes it off. Null: none.

lead.description: A quarter-circle lead-in and lead-out from the waste side onto the path. Null: none.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down into the material, mm/min.

select.description: What the operation cuts: the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id.

side.description:
Which side of the line the tool cuts: `outside` (cutting a part out), `inside` (a
hole) or `on` the line.

skin.description:
An onion skin: the passes stop `thickness` mm above the end depth, and one last lap
cuts through it. Null: none.

start_depth.description:
Where the cut starts, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top, more when an
earlier operation already cut down to there.

starts.description:
Where the cut starts, as points in drawing coordinates (mm): each moves the start of
the ring (contour) nearest to it. Empty: chosen by Chipload.

step_down.description:
The deepest each pass goes, mm. The passes are equal, and the last one ends exactly
at the end depth.

tabs.description:
Holding tabs left at the bottom of the cut, so a part cut out doesn't come loose.
Null: none.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`).

clearance.description:
How far the cut moves into the material that is kept, mm: positive removes more (a
larger pocket, a smaller part), negative leaves material. Less than the tool radius.

corners.description:
Dogbones or T-bones in the inside corners, so square parts fit. Null: the corners
stay round.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description:
Where the cut ends, mm down from the stock top. More than the start depth; below the
stock bottom only within `stock.max_overcut`.

entry.description:
How the tool goes down at the start of each pass: `plunge` (straight down; needs a
centre-cutting tool) or `ramp` along the path; pockets also `helix`. Missing:
plunge.

keep_tool_down.description:
Between rings, feed across at depth instead of lifting, where the move stays clear
of the walls and is at most a tool diameter. Missing: false.

lead.description:
A quarter-circle lead-in and lead-out from the cleared side onto the wall. Null:
none.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down into the material, mm/min.

rest.description:
Rest machining: clear only what a larger tool leaves in these shapes. Null: the
whole pocket.

round_corners.description: Round the corners of every ring but the one along the wall, for smoother motion.

select.description: What the operation cuts: the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id.

start_depth.description:
Where the cut starts, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top, more when an
earlier operation already cut down to there.

starts.description:
Where each wall ring starts, as points in drawing coordinates (mm): each moves the
start of the wall ring nearest to it. Empty: chosen by Chipload.

step_down.description:
The deepest each pass goes, mm. The passes are equal, and the last one ends exactly
at the end depth.

stepover.description:
The distance between the clearing rings, as a fraction of the tool diameter: more
than 0, at most 1.

strategy.description:
How the pocket is cleared: `{"type": "rings"}`. (`trochoidal` and `adaptive` were
removed in 0.14: such projects load but don't generate.) Missing: rings.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`).

oneOf.description:
V-carve: a V-bit follows the centre line of closed shapes, as deep as makes the cut
exactly as wide as the shape.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description:
The deepest the V-bit's tip may go, mm down from the stock top. Strokes that need
more are carved to it, narrower than drawn, with a warning.

feed.description: The feed, mm/min, for moves no steeper than 45°.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

plunge_feed.description: The feed for moves steeper than 45°, mm/min.

select.description: What the operation cuts: the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id.

start_depth.description:
The surface carved, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top, more to carve on a
floor an earlier pocket cut.

step_down.description: Carve in passes no deeper than this, mm. Null: one pass.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`).

oneOf.description: Follow path: the tool centre on the selected shapes, open or closed.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description:
Where the cut ends, mm down from the stock top. More than the start depth; below the
stock bottom only within `stock.max_overcut`.

entry.description: How the tool goes down at the start of each pass: `plunge` or `ramp` along the path.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down into the material, mm/min.

select.description: What the operation cuts: the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id.

start_depth.description:
Where the cut starts, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top, more when an
earlier operation already cut down to there.

step_down.description:
The deepest each pass goes, mm. The passes are equal, and the last one ends exactly
at the end depth.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`).

oneOf.description: Holes: drilled with a drill, bored with a helix with an endmill.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description:
Where the hole ends, mm down from the stock top. For a drill, the depth of its
point.

feed.description: A bore's feed round its helix and bottom circle, mm/min. A drill doesn't use it.

method.description: How the holes are cut: `drill` with a drill, or `bore` (a helix) with an endmill.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

plunge_feed.description: A drill's feed down, or a bore's feed straight down to the start depth, mm/min.

select.description:
What the operation cuts: the circles among the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id.
Other shapes are skipped with a note.

start_depth.description:
Where the cut starts, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top, more when an
earlier operation already cut down to there.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`).

Placement.description:
Where the imported drawing is put: a DXF point p goes to scale · turn(p) + (dx, dy),
turned and scaled about the DXF's origin.

quarter_turns.description:
Turned counter-clockwise about the DXF's origin, in quarter turns (0–3), after the
scale.

scale.description: Scaled about the DXF's origin by this factor, 0.001 to 1000; 1: as drawn.

oneOf.description:
Rings parallel to the walls, cut from the inside out. An empty struct variant (not a
unit one) so serde refuses stray fields here too.

Removed in 0.14: still read, so older projects load, but refused when generating
until switched to rings.

loop_radius.description: Removed in 0.14; kept so old projects load.

step.description: Removed in 0.14; kept so old projects load.

oneOf.description: Removed in 0.14, as `trochoidal`.

Rest.description:
Rest machining: the pocket clears only the material the larger tool `after_tool` can't
reach in its shapes.

after_tool.description: The id of the larger project tool whose leftovers this pocket clears.

layer.description: Every shape on this layer (upper or lower case don't matter).

Shape.description:
One shape of the drawing: imported from a DXF (`path`: lines and arcs, one shape per DXF
entity), or drawn in Chipload (`circle`, `rectangle`, `polyline`). One flat object:
`id`, `layer`, `kind`, then the fields of that kind.

angle.description: rectangle: its rotation about the centre, radians, counter-clockwise.

bulges.description:
polyline: one per segment, as in DXF: tan(sweep / 4); 0 straight, 1 a
counter-clockwise half circle, -1 clockwise.

closed.description: path, polyline: whether it ends where it starts.

dxf_handle.description:
path: the handle of the DXF entity it came from, which keeps its id when the DXF is
updated.

dxf_type.description: path: the DXF entity's type, e.g. LWPOLYLINE.

id.description: The shape's id, which operations select it by.

kind.description:
`path` (imported from a DXF), or a shape drawn in Chipload: `circle`, `rectangle`,
`polyline`.

length.description: rectangle: its size along its own X axis, mm.

segments.description: path: its lines and arcs, mm.

width.description: rectangle: its size along its own Y axis, mm.

Skin.description: An onion skin on a profile.

thickness.description: Left above the end depth until the last lap, mm: more than 0, at most the step down.

SourceIssue.description: An import-time issue that can't be recomputed from the shapes.

code.description:
What kind of issue, e.g. `duplicate` or `open_contour` (see the import page of the
guide).

oneOf.description: M3
M4

max_overcut.description: How far a cut may go below the stock bottom, into the spoilboard, mm.

origin.description:
Where the stock lies around the drawing's origin: its `bottom_left` corner or its
`center` there.

thickness.description: Thickness, mm. Depths count down from the top.

z_zero.description: Where Z0 is: the stock `top` or `bottom`.

flank_angle.description:
The slope of the tab's sides, radians: π/2 (90°) straight, less for sloped tabs a
ramped profile follows.

height.description: The bridge's thickness, up from the bottom of the cut, mm.

width.description: The bridge left on the part, along its edge, mm (the flat top of a sloped tab).

angle.description: V-bits: the included angle, radians. Null: unknown; a V-carve then refuses the tool.

center_cutting.description:
Whether it can plunge straight down. False: profiles ramp in and pockets go down
round a helix. Null: unknown.

diameter.description: Diameter, mm. For a V-bit, its widest cutting diameter.

flutes.description: Number of flutes, for the chip load. Null: unknown.

id.description: The tool's number: what operations name it by, and its T number in the G-code.

name.description: The library tool it came from, for reference.

rpm.description: Spindle speed, rpm. Needed to generate.

tip_diameter.description: V-bits: the flat tip's diameter, mm. Null: pointed.

ToolChange.description: How a job with several tools is written.

oneOf.description: One G-code file per tool group; the user changes the tool and sets Z zero between.
One file with `T<n> M6` at each change, for a sender that handles it.
Declared by the DXF ($INSUNITS).
The DXF declared none; the user chose.

WorkZero.description: Where the G-code's X0 Y0 is. The geometry never moves; only the output is translated.

oneOf.description:
The drawing's own origin (the only choice before work_zero existed). An empty struct
variant, not a unit one, so serde refuses stray fields here too.
A corner or the centre of the stock, as placed by `stock.origin`.
Any point, in drawing coordinates (mm).

x.description: X of the point, drawing coordinates, mm.

y.description: Y of the point, drawing coordinates, mm.

description: Schema version 18. Older files load through Chipload's migrations; this schema describes only the current version.

copies.description: Cut the part several times in a grid. Null: once.

drawing.description: The drawing: the shapes Chipload cuts, imported from a DXF or drawn in Chipload.

machine.description: The machine: post-processor, safe height, limits and zero.

operations.description: The operations, cut in this order.

schema_version.description: The version of the file format. Chipload upgrades older files when it reads them, and refuses newer ones.

tools.description: The tools the operations cut with.

written_by.description: The Chipload version that wrote the file, for reference.
